name_en: Board-Approved Cybersecurity Strategy
name_ar: استراتيجية أمن سيبراني معتمدة من مجلس الإدارة
en: Board resolution approving the cybersecurity strategy for critical systems; strategy document with sign-off date; annual review minutes; alignment mapping to national cybersecurity strategy objectives

name_en: Cybersecurity Budget and Resource Allocation for Critical Systems
name_ar: ميزانية الأمن السيبراني وتخصيص الموارد للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Approved annual cybersecurity budget line item; headcount plan for critical-system security roles; evidence that budget requests align to risk register priorities; board/executive approval of allocation

name_en: Cybersecurity Objectives and KPIs for Critical Systems
name_ar: أهداف ومؤشرات أداء الأمن السيبراني للأنظمة الحساسة
en: KPI dashboard with baseline, target, and actual metrics for critical systems; quarterly review reports presented to senior management; evidence of corrective actions where targets are missed

name_en: Cybersecurity Management Roles and Accountability
name_ar: أدوار إدارة الأمن السيبراني والمساءلة
en: Organizational chart showing CISO/cybersecurity function; role descriptions for all critical-system security roles; documented delegation of authority; evidence of security steering committee or equivalent governance body

name_en: Cybersecurity Reporting to Executive Management
name_ar: تقارير الأمن السيبراني لإدارة الوحدة التنظيمية
en: Management pack templates used for executive reporting; samples of quarterly cybersecurity reports including critical-system KPIs; board/executive sign-off or acknowledgement records

name_en: Integration with Enterprise Risk Management
name_ar: التكامل مع إدارة مخاطر المؤسسة
en: Risk register entries for critical systems visible in the enterprise risk register; evidence of risk escalation and treatment decisions; mapping between cyber risks and operational/strategic risks

name_en: Policy Framework Covering Critical Systems
name_ar: إطار السياسات الذي يشمل الأنظمة الحساسة
en: Policy inventory listing all applicable policies for critical systems with version, owner, and next-review date; approval records; evidence of annual review cycle completion

name_en: Policy Exception and Waiver Management
name_ar: إدارة الاستثناءات والإعفاءات من السياسات
en: Exception/waiver register for critical-system policy deviations; risk acceptance approvals at appropriate authority level; compensating control documentation; time-bounded waiver records with closure evidence

name_en: Policy Compliance Monitoring
name_ar: رصد الامتثال للسياسات
en: Compliance monitoring schedule and reports; evidence of automated policy checks (e.g., SIEM rules, configuration audits); non-compliance findings log with remediation tracking

name_en: Defined Cybersecurity Roles for Critical Systems
name_ar: تحديد أدوار الأمن السيبراني للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Job descriptions/role profiles for all cybersecurity positions covering critical systems; RACI matrix for critical-system security functions; evidence of role-based training completion

name_en: Separation of Duties for Critical Systems
name_ar: فصل المهام للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Separation-of-duties matrix for critical-system administrative functions; evidence of access reviews confirming no conflicting role assignments; compensating monitoring controls where SoD conflicts cannot be eliminated

name_en: Critical System Asset Risk Assessment
name_ar: تقييم مخاطر أصول الأنظمة الحساسة
en: Risk assessment methodology document; completed risk assessments for all critical systems with likelihood/impact ratings; risk treatment plans with owners and due dates; evidence of risk acceptance sign-offs

name_en: Threat Intelligence Integration into Risk Management
name_ar: دمج المعلومات الاستخباراتية عن التهديدات في إدارة المخاطر
en: Threat intelligence subscriptions or NCA/CERT feeds evidence; documented process for translating threat intel into risk register updates; board-pack sections referencing current threat landscape for critical systems

name_en: Risk Acceptance and Residual Risk Sign-off
name_ar: قبول المخاطر والموافقة على المخاطر المتبقية
en: Residual risk register with formal acceptance records signed by asset owners and senior management; evidence that accepted risks are reviewed at least annually; escalation records for risks exceeding appetite

name_en: Security Review Gate in Change Management
name_ar: بوابة مراجعة أمنية في إدارة التغييرات
en: Change management policy/procedure showing mandatory security review step; CAB minutes evidencing security sign-off for critical-system changes; rejected change records where security review failed; change-freeze calendar and approval records

name_en: Security Requirements in Project Lifecycles
name_ar: متطلبات الأمن السيبراني في دورات حياة المشاريع
en: Project charter templates showing mandatory security requirements section; security architecture review records for projects touching critical systems; penetration test reports before go-live; lessons-learned security entries

name_en: Post-Implementation Security Review
name_ar: مراجعة أمنية بعد التنفيذ
en: Post-implementation review (PIR) reports for critical-system changes including security findings; evidence that identified gaps are tracked in the risk/remediation register; baseline configuration snapshots taken post-implementation

name_en: Annual Internal Cybersecurity Audit of Critical Systems
name_ar: التدقيق الداخلي السنوي للأمن السيبراني للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Internal audit plan covering critical systems; completed audit reports with findings and risk ratings; management responses and remediation plans; evidence of closure verification for high/critical findings

name_en: Independent Third-Party Cybersecurity Assessment
name_ar: تقييم مستقل من طرف ثالث للأمن السيبراني
en: Engagement letter and scope for third-party assessment; assessment report with independent findings; management action plan and executive summary presented to board/senior management; evidence of at least bi-annual independent assessment

name_en: Compliance Review Against NCA Requirements
name_ar: مراجعة الامتثال لمتطلبات الهيئة الوطنية للأمن السيبراني
en: NCA CCC compliance self-assessment workbook; evidence of completion and submission/reporting as required; gap analysis and remediation roadmap; version-controlled compliance tracking register

name_en: Pre-Employment Background Screening for Critical-System Staff
name_ar: الفحص الأمني للموظفين قبل التوظيف للعاملين على الأنظمة الحساسة
en: HR screening policy referencing critical systems; background check completion records for all staff with access to critical systems; evidence of enhanced screening (criminal, financial, national security) for privileged roles; vendor/contractor screening evidence

name_en: Security Obligations in Employment Contracts and NDAs
name_ar: الالتزامات الأمنية في عقود العمل واتفاقيات السرية
en: Sample employment contract and NDA referencing cybersecurity obligations for critical-system access; evidence all critical-system staff have signed current NDA; disciplinary policy referencing security violations

name_en: Timely Access Revocation on Termination or Role Change
name_ar: إلغاء الوصول في الوقت المناسب عند انهاء الخدمة أو تغيير المهام
en: Offboarding checklist showing same-day or immediate revocation of critical-system access on termination; IAM evidence of account disablement timestamps relative to HR termination dates; periodic leavers reconciliation report

name_en: Mandatory Cybersecurity Awareness for Critical-System Users
name_ar: التوعية الإلزامية بالأمن السيبراني لمستخدمي الأنظمة الحساسة
en: Annual awareness training completion reports showing 100% of critical-system users; training content covering threats relevant to critical national infrastructure; phishing simulation results and trend tracking; non-completion escalation evidence

name_en: Specialist Cybersecurity Training for Critical-System Security Staff
name_ar: تدريب متخصص في الأمن السيبراني لموظفي أمن الأنظمة الحساسة
en: Training plans for cybersecurity roles; certification records (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CEH, or NCA-approved); CPD hours tracked per security professional; specialist training budget evidence

name_en: Social Engineering and Targeted Attack Awareness
name_ar: التوعية بالهندسة الاجتماعية والهجمات الموجهة
en: Targeted awareness content for privileged users on spear-phishing, vishing, and supply-chain social engineering; evidence of recurring simulations with privileged-user targeting; results reported to management

name_en: Comprehensive Critical-System Asset Inventory
name_ar: جرد شامل لأصول الأنظمة الحساسة
en: Asset management system export showing all critical-system hardware and software assets with owner, classification, location, and lifecycle status; evidence of automated discovery tool output reconciled against manual inventory; quarterly reconciliation reports

name_en: Asset Classification and Criticality Rating
name_ar: تصنيف الأصول وتقييم الأهمية الحساسة
en: Asset classification policy defining criticality tiers; classification labels/tags applied in asset register; evidence of criticality rating reviews; alignment mapping between asset criticality and protective control selection

name_en: Unauthorised Asset Detection and Response
name_ar: اكتشاف الأصول غير المصرح بها والاستجابة لها
en: Network Access Control (NAC) or 802.1X configuration evidence; alerts/logs for unauthorised device attempts on critical-system networks; documented response procedure for rogue asset detection; CMDB discrepancy reports and resolution records

name_en: Privileged Access Management (PAM) for Critical Systems
name_ar: إدارة الوصول المميز للأنظمة الحساسة
en: PAM solution deployment evidence (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust vault screenshots); privileged account inventory showing all admin/service accounts for critical systems; session recording configuration and sample session logs; just-in-time access provisioning records

name_en: Multi-Factor Authentication for Critical-System Access
name_ar: المصادقة متعددة العوامل للوصول إلى الأنظمة الحساسة
en: MFA policy requiring MFA for all remote and privileged access to critical systems; IAM system configuration showing MFA enforcement; MFA exception register with risk acceptance; authentication logs confirming MFA events

name_en: Least-Privilege Access Reviews for Critical Systems
name_ar: مراجعات الوصول بمبدأ الامتياز الأدنى للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Semi-annual access review reports for all critical systems showing approvals, revocations, and escalations; evidence of recertification workflow completion; comparison of access granted vs. access required (role alignment analysis)

name_en: Service and Application Account Governance
name_ar: حوكمة حسابات الخدمات والتطبيقات
en: Inventory of all service/application accounts with documented owners and business justification; evidence of strong unique passwords or managed secrets for service accounts; periodic review of service account privileges; decommission evidence for stale service accounts

name_en: Hardened Golden Image Baseline Management
name_ar: إدارة صور النظام المعززة الأساسية
en: Golden image library with version history and approval records; CIS Benchmark or equivalent hardening guide applied; comparison report between deployed systems and golden-image baseline (configuration drift report); process for updating and re-approving golden images

name_en: Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) for Critical Systems
name_ar: الكشف عن التهديدات والاستجابة لها على الأجهزة الطرفية للأنظمة الحساسة
en: EDR solution deployment report showing coverage percentage of critical-system endpoints; EDR policy configuration (real-time protection, isolation capability); sample detections and response actions; exclusion register reviewed for appropriateness

name_en: Application Whitelisting on Critical Systems
name_ar: القائمة البيضاء للتطبيقات على الأنظمة الحساسة
en: Application control policy and approved software inventory for critical systems; application whitelist configuration evidence (e.g., AppLocker, WDAC policies); block event logs showing enforcement; process for adding new approved applications

name_en: Patch and Vulnerability Remediation for Critical Systems
name_ar: تصحيح الثغرات ومعالجتها للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Patch management policy with critical-system SLAs (e.g., critical patches within 72 hours); patch compliance dashboards for critical systems; vulnerability scan reports with remediation tracking; exception/risk-acceptance records for deferred patches

name_en: Network Segregation Architecture for Critical Systems
name_ar: هيكل عزل الشبكات للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Network architecture diagrams (as-built, dated, approved) showing critical-system zones, DMZs, and isolation from corporate/internet networks; firewall rule-sets reviewed against the approved architecture; data-flow diagrams justifying every approved inter-zone communication

name_en: Firewall and Access Control List Management
name_ar: إدارة جدران الحماية وقوائم التحكم في الوصول
en: Firewall/ACL rule-set review reports (at least annual); evidence of rule-set against least-privilege principle (no any/any rules on critical-system interfaces); change records for firewall rules with business justification and security sign-off; unused rule identification and removal evidence

name_en: Out-of-Band Management Network
name_ar: شبكة الإدارة خارج النطاق
en: Network diagram showing dedicated out-of-band (OOB) management network separated from production traffic; OOB access logs showing management sessions; evidence that production and management traffic do not share the same network path; physical or cryptographic separation evidence

name_en: Intrusion Detection and Prevention on Critical Networks
name_ar: الكشف عن التسلل والوقاية منه على الشبكات الحساسة
en: IDS/IPS deployment evidence on critical-system network segments; signature/rule update cadence logs; SIEM integration confirming IDS/IPS alert ingestion; tuning documentation and false-positive management records; sample high-severity alert handling records

name_en: Data Classification Policy and Labelling
name_ar: سياسة تصنيف البيانات والتسمية
en: Data classification framework document with tier definitions (e.g., Public, Confidential, Restricted, Top Secret for national systems); data inventory/catalog for critical systems showing applied classifications; labelling configuration in DLP tools; evidence of classification reviews

name_en: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Controls for Critical Systems
name_ar: ضوابط منع فقدان البيانات للأنظمة الحساسة
en: DLP solution deployment scope showing coverage of critical-system data channels (email, USB, cloud upload, print); DLP policy configuration for critical-data-type detection; incident reports for DLP violations; quarterly DLP effectiveness reviews

name_en: Secure Data Disposal and Media Sanitisation
name_ar: التخلص الآمن من البيانات وتعقيم الوسائط
en: Media sanitisation policy citing NIST SP 800-88 or equivalent; destruction/sanitisation records for critical-system storage media; third-party certificate of destruction where applicable; evidence of degaussing or secure overwrite for reused media

name_en: Encryption of Data at Rest for Critical Systems
name_ar: تشفير البيانات المخزنة للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Encryption policy specifying approved algorithms (AES-256 minimum) for critical-system data at rest; storage encryption configuration evidence (full-disk, database TDE, or file-level); key management documentation; encryption compliance scan results

name_en: Encryption of Data in Transit for Critical Systems
name_ar: تشفير البيانات أثناء النقل للأنظمة الحساسة
en: TLS policy requiring TLS 1.2+ for all critical-system communications; certificate inventory with expiry tracking; scan results confirming no cleartext protocols (Telnet, FTP, HTTP) on critical-system interfaces; inter-system encryption configuration evidence

name_en: Cryptographic Key Management
name_ar: إدارة المفاتيح التشفيرية
en: Key management policy covering generation, distribution, rotation, revocation, and destruction; HSM deployment evidence for critical-system keys; key rotation schedule and completion records; key custodian role assignments and dual-control evidence

name_en: Backup Policy and Coverage for Critical Systems
name_ar: سياسة النسخ الاحتياطي وتغطيتها للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Backup policy defining RTO/RPO for each critical system; backup job completion logs showing consistent success; coverage report confirming all critical-system data is in scope; backup encryption evidence

name_en: Offline and Air-Gapped Backup Copies
name_ar: النسخ الاحتياطية غير المتصلة بالشبكة والمعزولة
en: Offline/air-gapped backup policy and architecture diagram; evidence of regular transfer to offline media (tape rotation logs, off-site vault receipts, or air-gapped cloud bucket policy); custody chain records; ransomware-resilience test results confirming offline copy integrity

name_en: Backup Restoration Testing for Critical Systems
name_ar: اختبار استعادة النسخ الاحتياطية للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Annual restoration test plans and results for all critical systems; documented RTO/RPO achievement evidence from tests; business sign-off on test results; discrepancies and improvement actions tracked

name_en: Regular Vulnerability Scanning of Critical Systems
name_ar: الفحص الدوري للثغرات الأمنية للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Authenticated vulnerability scan reports for critical systems (at least monthly); scan coverage report; CVSS scoring and business criticality-adjusted prioritisation; scan tool credentials evidence of authenticated scanning

name_en: Vulnerability Remediation SLAs for Critical Systems
name_ar: مستويات خدمة معالجة الثغرات للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Vulnerability remediation SLA policy (e.g., Critical: 24h, High: 7 days, Medium: 30 days for critical systems); remediation tracking dashboard for critical systems; SLA breach records and escalation evidence; risk acceptance for deferred critical findings

name_en: Vulnerability Intelligence and Zero-Day Response
name_ar: معلومات الثغرات والاستجابة لثغرات اليوم صفر
en: Subscription evidence for NCA CERT advisories and CVE feeds; documented zero-day response procedure; evidence of emergency patching or compensating controls deployed within defined hours for critical-system zero-days; tabletop exercise records covering zero-day scenario

name_en: Annual Penetration Testing of Critical Systems
name_ar: اختبار الاختراق السنوي للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Engagement scope document and tester qualifications (OSCP, CEH, or equivalent); penetration test report with methodology, findings, and risk ratings; management remediation plan; re-test confirmation for critical/high findings

name_en: Red Team and Adversarial Simulation Exercises
name_ar: تمارين الفريق الأحمر ومحاكاة الهجمات
en: Red team exercise scope and rules of engagement; exercise report with attack paths, indicators of compromise, and detection capability assessment; purple team debrief records; improvements to detection and response capability documented and tracked

name_en: Penetration Test Finding Remediation Tracking
name_ar: تتبع معالجة نتائج اختبار الاختراق
en: Penetration test finding register with status tracking from discovery to verified closure; evidence of security team and asset owner collaboration on remediation; escalation records for overdue critical findings; trend analysis across test cycles

name_en: Comprehensive Logging of Critical-System Events
name_ar: تسجيل شامل لأحداث الأنظمة الحساسة
en: Logging policy defining mandatory log sources for critical systems (authentication, privilege use, configuration changes, network flows, application errors); SIEM ingestion evidence for all mandatory sources; log completeness audit report; NTP synchronisation evidence for all log sources

name_en: Extended Log Retention for Critical Systems
name_ar: الاحتفاظ الموسع بسجلات الأنظمة الحساسة
en: Log retention policy specifying minimum 12-month online retention and 36-month archive for critical systems (exceeding ECC baseline); SIEM/log storage capacity plan; archived log retrieval test records; log integrity verification evidence (hash/WORM storage)

name_en: 24/7 SOC Monitoring for Critical Systems
name_ar: مراقبة مركز العمليات الأمنية على مدار الساعة للأنظمة الحساسة
en: SOC operational model documentation (in-house/MSSP/hybrid); SLA or OLA for critical-system alert response times; evidence of 24/7 analyst coverage; escalation runbooks for critical-system alert types; monthly SOC performance reports

name_en: SIEM Use-Case and Detection Rule Management
name_ar: إدارة حالات الاستخدام وقواعد الكشف في نظام إدارة المعلومات والأحداث الأمنية
en: SIEM use-case library covering critical-system specific attack scenarios (lateral movement, privilege escalation, data exfiltration); use-case review and update records; false-positive tuning documentation; threat-intelligence-driven rule additions evidenced

name_en: Incident Response Plan for Critical Systems
name_ar: خطة الاستجابة للحوادث الأمنية للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Incident response plan document specific to critical systems; playbooks for top threat scenarios (ransomware, DDoS, insider threat, supply-chain attack); tested escalation tree; evidence of annual tabletop exercise; NCA/relevant authority notification procedure

name_en: Mandatory NCA Incident Reporting
name_ar: الإبلاغ الإلزامي عن الحوادث إلى الهيئة الوطنية للأمن السيبراني
en: Incident classification matrix defining reportable incidents for critical systems; evidence of notification submissions to NCA within mandated timeframes for any qualifying incidents; notification templates and contact directory; drill records for notification procedure

name_en: Post-Incident Review and Lessons Learned
name_ar: مراجعة ما بعد الحادث والدروس المستفادة
en: Post-incident review (PIR) reports for all significant critical-system incidents; lessons-learned action log with owners and due dates; evidence of updates to playbooks, controls, or configurations based on PIR findings; trend analysis across incidents

name_en: Physical Access Control to Critical-System Facilities
name_ar: التحكم في الوصول المادي إلى مرافق الأنظمة الحساسة
en: Physical security policy for critical-system data centres and control rooms; multi-factor physical access records (card + PIN or biometric); visitor access logs and escort records; physical access review reports (at least semi-annual); tailgating prevention evidence (mantrap/turnstile)

name_en: CCTV and Environmental Monitoring
name_ar: الدوائر التلفزيونية المغلقة ورصد البيئة
en: CCTV coverage map for critical-system facilities showing no blind spots; footage retention policy (minimum 90 days for critical facilities); environmental monitoring alerts (temperature, humidity, water, smoke) with evidence of 24/7 alerting; alarm response records

name_en: Physical Media and Equipment Security
name_ar: أمن الوسائط المادية والمعدات
en: Asset tracking for all physical media and equipment within critical-system facilities; locked cabinet/cage evidence for removable media storage; movement log for equipment leaving the facility; decommissioning checklist including physical media sanitisation

name_en: Cyber-Resilience and BCP/DRP for Critical Systems
name_ar: الصمود السيبراني وخطط الاستمرارية والتعافي للأنظمة الحساسة
en: BCP/DRP documents explicitly addressing cyber disruption scenarios for each critical system; RTO/RPO targets for cyber incidents vs. physical incidents; evidence of BCM/DRP review at least annually and after major incidents; linkage to crisis management framework

name_en: Cyber-Specific BCP/DRP Testing
name_ar: اختبار خطط الاستمرارية والتعافي بسيناريوهات سيبرانية
en: Annual BCP/DRP test plan and results for critical systems including cyber-scenario exercises (e.g., ransomware, total system compromise); test evidence showing RTO/RPO achievement; gaps identified and tracked to closure; senior management sign-off on test results

name_en: Redundancy and Failover for Critical Systems
name_ar: التكرار وآليات تجاوز الفشل للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Architecture diagrams showing redundancy and failover design for critical systems; failover test records (at least annual) with documented RTO evidence; high-availability configuration review; single-point-of-failure assessment and remediation tracking

name_en: Crisis Management Integration for Cyber Incidents
name_ar: تكامل إدارة الأزمات لحوادث الأمن السيبراني
en: Crisis management plan referencing cyber scenarios; communication templates for national authorities, board, and public; evidence of crisis management exercises involving cyber scenarios; documented escalation triggers from cyber incident to crisis status

name_en: Third-Party Cybersecurity Due Diligence
name_ar: العناية الواجبة في الأمن السيبراني للأطراف الثالثة
en: Third-party cybersecurity assessment questionnaire/methodology; completed assessments for all suppliers with critical-system access; risk tiering of suppliers; evidence of assessment results influencing contract decisions; reassessment schedule and completion records

name_en: Contractual Cybersecurity Requirements for Critical-System Suppliers
name_ar: المتطلبات التعاقدية للأمن السيبراني لموردي الأنظمة الحساسة
en: Contract templates and signed agreements including cybersecurity clauses (right to audit, incident notification, data protection, NCA compliance obligations); evidence of clause review and legal sign-off; evidence of supplier obligations communicated and acknowledged

name_en: Third-Party Access Control to Critical Systems
name_ar: التحكم في وصول الأطراف الثالثة إلى الأنظمة الحساسة
en: Third-party access provisioning process requiring business justification and CISO/security approval; PAM-managed or time-limited access tokens for vendor access; session recording logs for third-party privileged sessions; access removal confirmation after engagement end

name_en: Ongoing Third-Party Cybersecurity Monitoring
name_ar: الرصد المستمر للأمن السيبراني للأطراف الثالثة
en: Annual third-party reassessment schedule and completion evidence; evidence of monitoring third-party security incidents or breaches affecting critical systems; supplier security performance KPIs tracked; escalation records for underperforming suppliers

name_en: Cloud Adoption Restrictions and Approvals for Critical Systems
name_ar: قيود اعتماد الحوسبة السحابية والموافقات للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Cloud policy defining prohibited, restricted, and permitted cloud services for critical-system data; evidence of NCA/regulatory approval for any cloud hosting of critical systems; data residency compliance evidence (Saudi Arabia geolocation of processing/storage); cloud risk assessment records

name_en: Cloud Security Controls and Shared Responsibility
name_ar: ضوابط أمن السحابة والمسؤولية المشتركة
en: Shared responsibility matrix for each cloud provider used for critical systems; Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) tool deployment evidence; cloud configuration compliance reports (CIS Cloud Benchmark); evidence of customer-side controls compensating for provider limitations

name_en: Cloud Exit Strategy for Critical Systems
name_ar: استراتيجية الخروج من الحوسبة السحابية للأنظمة الحساسة
en: Cloud exit plan per critical-system cloud workload; evidence of data portability testing; contractual data-return and deletion clauses; exit strategy reviewed at least annually; evidence of senior management approval of exit plan
